title: Explain and fix a slow query
prompt: The query in slow.sql scans the whole table. Add the index it needs in index.sql (one CREATE INDEX statement), keeping slow.sql unchanged.
check: sqlite3 shop.db < index.sql && sqlite3 shop.db "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT * FROM movement WHERE account_id = 42 AND booked_on >= '2026-01-01';" | grep -qi 'using index'
